The '''Yuga system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Sanbra sector/Legends|Sanbra sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yuga 2]].
